title: Weekly training summary
description: A deterministic weekly aggregation of training volume and load.

weekStart.description: The Monday starting the ISO week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

activityCount.description: The number of activities in the week.

totalDurationSeconds.description: The total activity duration in seconds.

totalTrainingStressScore.description: The total normalized training stress accumulated in the week.

sportBreakdown.description: The weekly training stress grouped by sport.
